current: Section 1.  Termination for Casualty.  If the Leased Premises are damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, Base Rent and Additional Rent shall abate in full of the date of such damage until the Leased Premises are restored and Tenant is able to resume normal production operations. Landlord shall, within thirty (30) days after the casualty, deliver to Tenant Landlord’s good-faith estimate of the time required to complete restoration. Tenant may terminate this Lease by written notice given at any time before substantial completion if (a) Landlord’s restoration estimate exceeds ninety (90) days from the date of casualty, (b) the cost to restore exceeds ten percent (10%) of the replacement cost of the Leased Premises, (c) restoration is not substantially completed within thirty (30) days after the estimated completion date, or (d) the casualty occurs during the final twenty-four (24) months of the then-current Term. Upon any such termination, any unearned rent paid in advance shall be refunded and the Security Deposit returned in full. Landlord shall have no right to terminate this Lease by reason of casualty.
